finding: Direct chassis contact (no cloth) is WORSE than the 0.5in soft cloth at the same palm-rest spot.
interpretation: Metal-to-metal contact couples structure-borne vibration/buzz that raises the noise floor (~11 dB SNR penalty), despite shorter delay spread. The soft cloth is acoustically beneficial, not incidental. Adaptive sounder correctly dropped to QPSK and linked cleanly rather than failing at 16-QAM. Confirms the legacy walkthrough's chassis-contact warning, now quantified.
